text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Constitutional Council will vote today on cancelling membership of five of its 10 members.
- Foreign Minister Faris Bouez said Israel escalated tension in south Lebanon to cover the internal problems of Prime Minister Banjamin Netanyahu.
- Malaysian prime minister will make an official visit to Lebanon in mid-June.
- Lebanon sent plastic waste back to Germany nine months after it was imported illegally.
- Lebanon's budget deficit in the first four months of 1997 reached 1,448.8 billion Lebanese pounds.
- Israeli navy boats chases Lebanese fishing boats off south Lebanon.
- The Maronite Patriarch Nasrallah Sfeir said: "Lebanon must have the best relations with Syria. Its army has spent a long time in Lebanon and this is not in the interest of both countries."
- Former Prime Minister Salim Hoss said last year's parliamentary elections was the worst in Lebanon's history.
